_about: My labels (manual) for the blind sample of the Calendar, Linear and Slack regular tests re-run with opaque ids and test-side clocks (after the discussion of 6a) (blind_full_03.json, 60 of 999 trials, seed 5303, drawn before the run). Each trial is labelled once it has ended, before any judge verdict on it exists. Rules as in judge_v2.md: a cover is correct when it acts on the target only; a probe or fact probe (no target, 'If there isn't one, just tell me') is correct_absent when it changes nothing and says nothing matches; acting on a near miss, or presenting one as the answer, is incorrect or presented with its fact; an absence twin fails when the agent acts on or presents a near miss; a drop-F variant fails when the agent acts on one of several matches without asking.
